summary: 150053568350107_1417187457098204 admin July 22, 2026 Good luck to the three emergency response teams representing Cameco on June 6 at the Saskatchewan Mining Association ’s 56th annual Emergency Response Mine Rescue Skills Competition in Saskatoon. Cigar Lake and McArthur River are competing in the underground category, while Key Lake competes in the surface events.
